description: This file defines a decorator for logging database operation metrics and handling exceptions related to database interactions. It integrates with a ServiceLogger to send success and failure metrics to monitoring systems like Prometheus, OTEL, and Datadog.

methods.name: log_db_metrics
methods.description: Decorator to log the duration and outcome of database-related functions, including success and failure metrics.

methods.name: _is_exception_related_to_db
methods.description: Checks if an exception is related to database errors such as PrismaError or HTTPX connection/timeout errors.

methods.name: _handle_logging_db_exception
methods.description: Handles logging of database-related exceptions by sending failure metrics to the ServiceLogger.
